subject: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>, James Li <james.li@carelynx.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

Team —

Happy to hand off CareLynx. Quick context so CS/Implementation have the right lift:
- Deal: RDW-2339-CLX (signed, 12-month subscription; reserved capacity: 2k concurrent tokens throughput)
- Customer: CareLynx (clinical workflow + patient messaging). Primary champion: Emily Park (PM). Procurement: James Li.
- Key dates: kickoff w/ customer 2027-03-10; pilot (alpha) target 2027-04-07; production go-live 2027-05-03.
- Scope: chat generation + embeddings for record search; SSO via Okta (OIDC); VPC peering planned (private deployment in us-west-2); data retention 90 days; logs stored in customer S3.
- Risk/asks: customer requires SOC2 evidence + network diagram before kickoff; procurement needs final SOW signed and PO—James said they’ll upload PO once SOW is countersigned.

Attachments: I’ve attached the mutual action plan (MAP) and signed SOW stub. HubSpot deal link and DocuSign are below.

Action items I’m requesting from you:
1) Tessa — please own CS lead and run kickoff on 3/10. Recommend a 60-min agenda (intro, expectations, success metrics, escalation path).
2) Monica — please own implementation planning and staffing; can you confirm PM + SA allocation and provide estimated effort hours by 3/4?
3) Neha — please validate what security evidence we need to present pre-kickoff (SOC2 cert, pen-test summary, network diagram) and whether the VPC plan has additional constraints.

Customer expectations: low-latency answers for triage flows, 99.9% uptime SLA preferred (they’re asking about an elevated SLA—legal flagged as possible add-on), and strict retention. Emily is sensitive about PHI—we told her platform will be deployed in a private VPC and logs can be routed to their S3.

I’ll stay looped for the first two weeks of onboarding. Please reply with assigned owners and any blockers.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CareLynx_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (worksheet), SOW_CareLynx_signed.pdf (contract stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

Thanks Vivek — I’ll take CS lead and confirm kickoff agenda. Prelim notes:
- I propose the 3/10 kickoff at 10:00 PT (Emily confirmed availability for morning).
- Success metrics we should lock: average latency under 300ms for 95th pct, false-positive rate for routing under 3%, and demonstrable embedding recall > 85% on provided dataset.
- I'll prepare a short onboarding checklist to circulate before the kickoff (roles, access, test data, escalation matrix).

Monica — do you have capacity to staff an SA for the alpha window? If you can put a placeholder SA (8 hours/week initially) we can refine after sprint 0.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

I can take PM lead for implementation. Quick staffing plan and estimates:
- Monica Patel (Implementation PM) — full-time during sprint 0 (2 weeks) then 0.5 FTE until go-live.
- Assigned Solutions Architect: Rajesh Nair (sa_rajesh@redwood.com) — placeholder through alpha (8 hrs/week).
- QA/Integration Engineer: 40 hrs during alpha period.
- Estimated effort: sprint 0 (2 weeks): 120 hrs; alpha stabilization: 160 hrs; production enablement: 80 hrs.

Open items for kickoff:
- Okta test tenant details (Emily — can you share admin invite or test credentials?)
- VPC peering CIDR and who manages peering (CareLynx infra team or our infra?).
- Expected daily token volume during alpha to size autoscaling.

I’ll draft a 30/60/90 plan and share by 3/4 EOD.

Monica Patel
Implementation Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>, James Li <james.li@carelynx.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

Looping in security readiness notes. Emily / James — to satisfy pre-kickoff items we can provide:
1) SOC2 Type II report (redacted) — available now.
2) Network diagram and VPC peering checklist — need CIDR and expected endpoints from CareLynx.
3) Data flows doc showing how PHI is redacted/pseudonymized before indexing — I will prepare a short onepager.

Questions for procurement: James — do you have any encryption-at-rest key management requirements? We support KMS integrations and HSM if needed; please advise.

I will attach the security onepager and the standard SOC2 attestation.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>, James Li <james.li@carelynx.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

Great — attaching the latest signed SOW (pdf). James — let me know if SOW countersign triggers PO; Emily said procurement will start the PO once they have the final countersigned SOW and the mutual action plan.

Security docs: Neha, I added the SOC2 link and the network diagram for our standard VPC peering template. Monica — CIDR from CareLynx is 10.10.0.0/16 per Emily’s last note. Emily — can you confirm who on your infra team will accept the peering request?

Also noting: Emily asked about a 99.95% SLA as a commercial ask. I’ve flagged to legal and finance and will update if we move forward with SLA add-on.

Vivek

Attachments sent: SOW_CareLynx_signed.pdf (signed contract)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@carelynx.com>, James Li <james.li@carelynx.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareLynx implementation: owners, go-live milestones, and SSO/retention notes

Final owner assignments and next steps:
- CS Lead: Tessa Morgan (owner of success plan and weekly check-ins)
- Implementation PM: Monica Patel (owner of sprint plan & deliverables)
- Solutions Architect: Rajesh Nair (tech lead)
- Security Owner: Neha Kapoor (compliance checklist + pre-kickoff artifacts)

Immediate next steps (owners and due dates):
- Monica: share 30/60/90 plan and resource calendar by 3/4 EOD (IN PROGRESS).
- Neha: SOC2 onepager and VPC checklist to be shared by 3/5 12:00 PT.
- Emily/James: upload PO and Okta test tenant invite by 3/8.
- Tessa: send kickoff agenda and meeting invite for 3/10 10:00 PT (will do once Monica confirms staff).

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround. If anyone sees a blocker, flag here and I’ll escalate.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
